purpose: silver_airport_weather holds hourly weather observations for three New York-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA), combining measured conditions (temperature, dewpoint, humidity, wind direction/speed/gust, precipitation, pressure, visibility) with static airport reference attributes (name, municipality, elevation, longest runway) and a pipeline capture timestamp.
usage: Read the table at the grain of one row per airport per UTC observation hour, keyed by airport_code and observed_hour_utc; use observed_date_local and observed_hour_local to filter or group by local calendar time, and join or filter on airport_code for the denormalized airport attributes.
limitations: The profile cannot confirm the declared grain against the warehouse; wind_gust_mph is null for about 74.6% of rows and pressure_mb for about 11.5%, limiting completeness of those readings; airport_elevation_ft and airport_longest_runway_ft are static per-airport values repeated across rows rather than per-observation measurements, which a reviewer should re-check; captured_at appears to be a pipeline load timestamp rather than business data even though the profile does not flag it as airbyte metadata, and no column in this profile is flagged is_airbyte_metadata true.
